title: Improper Control of Filename for Include/Require Statement in PHP Program ('PHP Remote File Inclusion') vulnerability…
description: A vulnerability classified as PHP Remote File Inclusion exists in Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates) up to version 2.0.26. This flaw involves improper control of filenames used in include/require statements, allowing PHP Local File Inclusion. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
